To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the results of Abhyankaran--Jung and Artin--Maur on algebraic power functions over Henselian fields are valid over Henselian rings.
the theorems on algebraic power expansions, implicit functions, and the closedness theorem hold over Henselian (rank one) valued fields, as long as the field has a definable valuation ring.
the theorems on algebraic power expansions hold over Henselian fields and, in particular, over valued fields of rank 1.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a study of the structure of algebraic power series and functions over valued fields.
a systematic development of the theory of algebraic power series, which is a basic tool in analysis of definable functions.

the theory of algebraic power series is a powerful tool in the study of definable functions.
